shots.focal_element: Kate (HR) standing in an office kitchenette, addressing the camera in a pink blazer, framed left of centre
shots.typography: Lower-third name tag bottom-left with no background plate: name in bold white sans-serif, title case; role line beneath in regular-weight white sans-serif, title case, normal tracking; geometric grotesk look (font name not identifiable, low confidence)
shots.what_happens: Live-action talking-head: Kate delivers the platform pitch to camera with open-hand gestures (w183-w202, 'With ServiceNow's AI platform, all the urgent but not so exciting stuff is taken care of with super exciting automation'), building to a sarcastic, emphatic 'super exciting' with raised fists; the name/role lower third is visible for most of the shot and gone by about 1:04.5.
shots.build_rebuild: Place a locked-off presenter clip full-frame and overlay a two-line bottom-left lower third (bold white name, regular white role, no plate) that fades in at shot start and fades out about 1 s before the cut.

shots.focal_element: Woman in green satin blouse holding a phone and mug on the right third, speaking; older colleague typing on a tablet on the left
shots.what_happens: Quick live-action cutaway at a meeting table: the woman in green delivers one line, 'Provisioning hardware and software' (w203-w206), then looks up smugly while her colleague keeps working.
shots.build_rebuild: Cut to a ~1 s two-shot of an employee speaking a single benefit line, with soft background focus, timed so the line ends just as the shot ends.

shots.focal_element: Woman in a black blazer turning to speak from behind two seated colleagues in front of a teal wall and corkboard
shots.what_happens: Opens on a motion-blurred whip pan away from the previous table setup (about 1:06.5), lands on a three-person office group where the woman in black says 'Security credentials setting access levels' (w207-w211); by about 1:08.0 the frame has already moved to a closer over-the-shoulder angle on her.
shots.build_rebuild: Join the previous clip to this one with a fast horizontal whip (6-8 frames of directional motion blur) and land on a group shot where the next employee delivers the next list item.

shots.focal_element: Curly-haired man in a navy jacket in close-up on the left, glancing sideways; the woman in black is soft in the background right
shots.transition_other: Continuous camera move with a rack focus from the woman in black (in focus at 1:08.5) to the man in the foreground; looks like the same take that the cut detector split, not an edit
shots.what_happens: Comic beat: the focus pulls to the man, who adds 'In free food notifications' and a sly aside, 'I haven't paid for food in like 10 months' (w212-w224), with knowing side-eye looks while the woman behind him rolls her eyes.
shots.build_rebuild: Hold a shallow-depth-of-field close-up, pull focus from the background speaker to the foreground character for a deadpan punchline, and cut on the last word.

shots.focal_element: Kate back in the kitchenette, doing a small celebratory shoulder dance with fists up
shots.what_happens: Back to Kate's to-camera setup for the wrap line, 'And all this super fun stuff happens autonomously' (w225-w232), played with a goofy little dance and grimace that send up the 'fun' list; no lower third this time.
shots.build_rebuild: Return to the presenter's locked-off setup with no graphics and let her deliver the summary line with physical comedy before cutting back to the office group.
